newsitem.title: USA: Pope Resources sets cash distribution.
newsitem.headline: Pope Resources sets cash distribution.

text.p: Pope Resources LP on Monday announced a cash distribution of $0.70 per unit, payable on April 15, to unitholders of record on March 31.
"This is the first of four quarterly cash distributions that the company plans to make in 1997," president and chief executive officer Gary Tucker said in a statement.

Tucker said the remaining three distributions will follow in June, September and December and that the distributions are aimed at assisting unitholders in meeting their federal and state income tax liability attributable to the company's flow-through income.
Quarterly distributions will vary in amount as they will track with current quarterly earnings expectations, the company said.
Pope Resources owns 76,000 acres of timberland and development property in the Puget Sound area of Washington state.
